about_content: From a young age, I was captivated by the magic of technology—where lines of code transform ideas into reality. Born in 2005, my journey into the world of programming began in 2018. Initially driven by pure curiosity, I soon discovered that coding was a passion that fueled my desire to build innovative solutions. Over the years, I’ve delved into diverse languages such as Python, JavaScript, and even experimented with C++, all while developing creative projects ranging from dynamic Discord bots to compelling web experiences. Every project is a new opportunity to learn, experiment, and push the boundaries of digital creativity.
biography_intro: Hello! I'm Sobhan, known online as Mr.Sinre or Sobhan-SRZA. Born on November 22, 2005, I'm 19 years old as of 2024. I’m passionate about coding, watching movies and anime, sports, and reading. In my free time, I enjoy gaming and daydreaming about the future with music in the background.

biography_timeline.start_description: In 2018, I began my journey as a content creator under the name S.R.Z.A, inspired by authors using initials. I started a channel on Aparat uploading movies and cartoons, gaining decent views but no income. Later, I pivoted to Instagram, rebranding as S.R.Z.A ACTION, and grew to 1600 followers by posting funny videos and memes.
biography_timeline.pause_description: School commitments forced me to pause content creation in 2020. Despite a decent following on Aparat (500 followers, 5M views), I couldn’t continue due to academic pressures.
biography_timeline.resume_description: In 2021, I restarted with a focus on gaming, launching S.R.Z.A GAMER. I uploaded PUBG Mobile gameplay videos to YouTube and Aparat, learning video editing with Filmora. I created Minecraft series (Survival and Bedwars) and Call of Duty content, reaching 50 subscribers and 2K views.
biography_timeline.discord_description: While exploring YouTube, I discovered Discord and its vibrant gaming community. I created a server and learned about Discord bots. Starting with Python, I modified bot source codes and built music bots (DJ BOY, DJ GIRL). Later, I developed Ordak Farangi, a versatile bot, and shared its code on GitHub, connecting with other developers.
biography_timeline.university_description: In 2023, I graduated high school and joined Azad University to balance military service and focus on coding. I improved my skills in Python, JavaScript, and C++, working on Discord bots like Ticker Boy and earning a small income from client projects.
biography_timeline.current_description: Now, with solid knowledge of Discord.js, Python, JavaScript, and C++, I continue contributing to GitHub and Discord. YouTube was a setback, but I’m focused on projects like HyCom, Ticker Boy, DJ BOY, and Padio. I have big ideas for programming but am limited by time and studies.
